description: Real NVDA chain rows captured 2026-08-17, used to pin the per-contract liquidity gate. Shared by the TypeScript gate (apps/server/src/lib/options/gate.ts) and the Python backtest gate (services/quant/app/gate.py) so the two implementations cannot drift apart unnoticed. Prices are in whole dollars for readability; both readers convert to E4.

cases.note: Deepest volume on the board. The candidate set looks like this.
Next strike up, still 3-6% round trip.
Cheap but genuinely traded — must pass. A gate that rejects this is too strict.
In the money, wide-ish but inside tolerance.
Below the minimum price, and a 1-cent tick on a 7.5-cent mid is a 13% spread. Cheap and wide are the same failure at this end of the board.
A penny contract with real open interest. Volume does not rescue a 1.5-cent mid quoted 0.01/0.02 — that is a 67% round trip.
Zero bid — literally unsellable. Its 435.84% quoted IV is a solver artifact.
The case that disproved a per-underlying gate: NVDA, but a 20% round trip AND a mid beneath intrinsic value of 17.55.
13% round trip on a liquid-looking row.
Deep ITM with no participants at all. Spread alone would have let it through.
